The fractional-perturbation sentence also omitted the California LI+ total and OC-EP contrasts.

verify_repository.note: Final read-only verification after the acceptance record, the title-encoding repair, the regenerated review slices and its builder joined the manifest.

limitations: The 90/180/365-day blocks are paired calendar-block summaries; adjacent blocks are dependent, so nominal MDEs are descriptive multi-scale sensitivities rather than calibrated frequentist guarantees.
Table cells are rounded independently from the unrounded block quantities; the displayed product of a rounded SE and 1.96 can differ from the displayed MDE in the last digit.
The audit verifies the enumerated claim bindings and a curated canonical set; it does not re-run the original regional fits or synthetic campaigns.
The Slice 1 tightened visibility display remains documented as withdrawn; the sealed computation is retained for historical identity but is not a current reader-facing claim.
The expanded New Zealand block increased the manuscript from 252 to 253 pages and shifted the appendix by one page; the review-slice PDF ranges were updated accordingly.

The 26 new Slice 7 ledger bindings cover the split New Zealand MDE cells and the expanded California fractional perturbations; the audit's independent MDE check covers every displayed table cell whether or not it is an enumerated claim.
